protocol: Each group: training target mean; 500 samples per generator; fixed training group reference. VAE model uses development validation for early stopping. The real subsample is compared against the remainder of the training group. In-sequence shuffle preserves base composition only.
interpretation_boundary: Training-distribution fit is not independent validation. Consensus matches are exploratory sequence patterns under a hypothesized TSS alignment, not experimentally confirmed motifs or activity.
assumed_alignment: 50 bp ordered 5-prime to 3-prime, positions -50 through -1; TSS +1
scan_rule: TTGACA start -35; TATAAT start -12; allow <=1 mismatch, scan radius +/-1 bp. Sensitivity uses both starts shifted -5/+5 bp and radius +/-5 bp. Paired match requires any hit in each window; it does not enforce independent spacer or validate a binding site.
